crossRefs.note: Aaron shall burn incense of sweet spices on it every morning. When he tends the lamps, he shall burn it.

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: and he burned incense of sweet spices on it, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
translations.bsb: and he burned fragrant incense on it, just as the LORD had commanded him.
translations.kjv: And he burnt sweet incense thereon; as the LORD commanded Moses.
translations.asv: and he burnt thereon incense of sweet spices; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
